title: Telemetry-driven ingest catalog and autosummary scaffold for onboarding
author: Maya Chen
description: Context and motivation: onboarding at scale requires prioritizing model intake and release notes based on real usage signals. This PR adds a telemetry-weighted ingest catalog that merges intake manifests with sampled telemetry to surface high-impact variants during onboarding, plus an autosummary generator that drafts concise release micro-digests for the model registry UI and release pipeline. The feature aims to reduce curation time and improve changelog relevance by ranking changes using measured signal (latency, error-rate, token-cost delta, and usage share). What this changes: 1) catalog indexer that annotates model intake with sampled telemetry fingerprints and impact score; 2) autosummary module that synthesizes short release snippets and suggested human review bullets; 3) lightweight provenance ledger entries for each intake that record sampler seed and telemetry snapshot; 4) small docs and onboarding checklist to guide SME reviewers. Backwards compatibility: ingest manifests remain compatible; the catalog adds optional telemetry fields and will gracefully ignore missing telemetry. Migration: operator can enable the telemetry annotator via a feature flag and backfill is provided (best-effort sample-based). See release_notes for user-facing summary.
commits_summary: 4 commits: (1) catalog: add telemetry indexer and score model; (2) autosummary: initial generator, template and scorer; (3) tests and sample fixtures; (4) docs and migration script. Commits include small refactors to intake schema to add optional telemetry fields with JSON schema bump (non-breaking).

Maya Chen (author): Added guard and updated tests in commit 3; the backfill script emits a summary when telemetry missing and leaves fields null.
Zoe Kaplan (review): Could we avoid storing raw telemetry in the registry? Suggest storing only fingerprints and derived metrics. Also add a short privacy note in docs.
Maya Chen (author): Switched to fingerprint + aggregates, updated provenance ledger to store only seed and aggregate metrics. Privacy note added to docs.
Lukas Meyer (review): CI flaky on test_autosummary; please stabilize by removing timing-dependent assertions.
Maya Chen (author): Replaced timing assertions with deterministic fixture; pushed fix in commit 4. CI rerun OK.
Zoe Kaplan (approval): LGTM after changes. Rohan Patel (approval): Approved.

merge_outcome: Merged via squash-and-merge. Merge commit message: "telemetry-led ingest catalog + autosummary scaffold; non-breaking schema opt-in; docs and tests."
release_notes:
- Add telemetry-weighted ingest catalog that annotates intake manifests with impact scores to prioritize onboarding.
- Introduce autosummary generator to draft concise release micro-digests for registry UI and release notes.
- Add optional provenance ledger entries and backfill script; opt-in via feature flag.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated: REDWOOD_REGISTRY_TELEMETRY=true. Backfill script: scripts/backfill_telemetry_sample.py --batch-size 500. Monitor new metric registry.ingest.telemetry.annotated_count and autosummary.generated_count for rollout.
